criteria.criterion: Use Stack Overflow tagged search for python+pandas (no sign-in)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did reach the correct tagged listing for python+pandas and did not sign in. No blockers (CAPTCHA/login wall) are shown. Baseline full credit remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Apply required filters and sort order
criteria.final_justification: The agent successfully configured/verified two requirements in the UI: within last year (Days old 365) and sort by votes/score (“Highest score”). However, the task requires additionally filtering for score ≥ 50 and accepted answer. The agent neither applied these via search operators/query params nor performed a reliable manual verification workflow; and its claim that these are “not directly configurable” doesn’t complete the requirement. Therefore only partial credit is warranted (some correct filtering/sorting, but missing two hard constraints).

criteria.criterion: Report top 3 matching questions (title, score, view count)
criteria.final_justification: This criterion requires reporting the top three matching questions’ titles, scores, and view counts after applying all constraints. The agent provided none. Also, its conclusion (“no questions shown with scores ≥ 50”) is contradicted by screenshots showing high-score questions in other states, and the agent did not demonstrate a complete, correctly-filtered result set to justify “no qualifying questions exist.” This is a critical failure for the required output fields, so the score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Respect interaction constraints and stopping condition
criteria.final_justification: The agent respected the interaction constraints (no sign-in; no prohibited actions). But the stopping condition was not met because the filters were not fully enforced/verified (score≥50 and accepted answer) and no three matching records were identified. Still, this criterion is primarily about avoiding prohibited actions; baseline full credit is reasonable.
